student_learning_goal: I can measure perimeter and pick the right metric unit.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can measure perimeter and pick the right metric unit.
header.character_watermark: Roo the Ruler Rabbit in the top-right with a ruler and tape measure. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: For 4 polygons, add up all sides to find the perimeter.
parts.visual_layout: Four polygon icons with side lengths labelled and an answer line for each perimeter total.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 perimeter layout for measurement worksheet, B&W line art. 4 polygons with sides labelled: triangle (4cm,5cm,3cm), square (6cm), hexagon (2cm sides), rectangle (8cm,4cm). Each with answer line.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS01_P1_PERIM at Part 1: keywords name the polygon icons with side lengths.

parts.student_instructions: For 4 objects, circle the BEST unit: mm, cm, m, or km.
parts.visual_layout: Four object icons with four unit labels to circle for each.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 unit picker for measurement worksheet, B&W line art. 4 objects: ant (mm), pencil (cm), table (m), highway (km). Each with circles labelled mm, cm, m, km.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS01_P2_UNITS at Part 2: keywords name the objects and unit choices.

parts.student_instructions: Draw a rectangle with perimeter 16 cm. Label sides.
parts.visual_layout: Empty rectangle workspace with side-label lines.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 polygon building space for measurement worksheet, B&W line art. Empty workspace with note: 'Perimeter = 16 cm'. Side-label lines around a sample dotted rectangle.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS01_P3_BUILD at Part 3: keywords name the build a rectangle space.

parts.answer_key: Any rectangle whose 4 sides sum to 16 (e.g., 6+2+6+2 or 5+3+5+3 or 4+4+4+4).

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, find perimeter of your desk in cm.
teacher_notes: Lesson 1 consolidation. Diagnostic — check addition and unit choice.
